verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no dedicated data-export feature. The only route out is indirect: the API lets you 'programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon', and the MCP server can read issues, accounts, and contacts, so data could be extracted with custom tooling. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), proof that all data types (messages, KB, analytics, custom objects) are exportable, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of a successful migration off Pylon.
